# Classic Roman Carbonara 🍝

> "Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication." — Leonardo da Vinci

## Core Ingredients
- [x] **Guanciale** (200g, cured pork jowl diced into lardons)
- [x] **Pecorino Romano** (100g, finely microplaned)
- [x] **Fresh Eggs** (4 large yolks + 1 whole egg)
- [ ] **Rigatoni or Spaghetti** (400g bronze-die cut)
- [x] **Tellicherry Black Pepper** (freshly cracked)

## Technique Steps
1. Render guanciale over medium-low heat until crisp and deep amber.
2. Whisk egg yolks with pecorino and abundant black pepper into a thick paste.
3. Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente (*riserva l'acqua di cottura*).
4. Toss pasta with rendered fat, temper with pasta water, fold in egg cream off heat.

> [!NOTE]
> Authentic Roman carbonara contains no heavy cream. The glossy sauce forms naturally from emulsifying hot starchy cooking water with the rich egg-pecorino paste.
